description: Classic SaaS landing: sticky blurred header, radial-gradient hero, logo strip, three feature cards with icon tiles, dark CTA band.

referenceProfile.thesis: Conversion ladder: indigo accent repeats from eyebrow pill to primary button to icon tile, guiding the eye from claim to action across neutral white sections.
signatureMoves: A radial indigo glow behind the hero centers attention without imagery.
Feature icons sit in identical indigo-tinted tiles to make the trio scan as one system.
transferPreserve: Reserve indigo for actions and icon tiles; alternate white sections with one dark CTA band.
transferAvoid: Do not introduce a second accent hue or dense paragraphs inside feature cards.
